headlines.description: — Brady Tkachuk and Fabian Zetterlund had a goal and an assist each as the Ottawa Senators defeated the Montreal Canadiens 5-2 in a heavy-hitting game between two Atlantic Division rivals Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tkachuk, Zetterlund lead Ottawa Senators past Montreal Canadiens 5-2

events.name: Boston Bruins at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Moritz Seider had a goal and two assists, and the Detroit Red Wings snapped a four-game losing streak by holding off the Boston Bruins for a 5-4 victory on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seider helps the struggling Red Wings beat the Bruins 5-4

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat and Anthony Duclair scored to lead the New York Islanders past Tampa Bay 2-1 on Tuesday night, ending the Lightning's seven-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Horvat and Duclair score as Islanders end Lightning's 7-game win streak with 2-1 victory

events.name: Dallas Stars at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Vladislav Gavrikov scored just over a minute into overtime and the New York Rangers beat Dallas 3-2 on Tuesday night, ending the Stars' four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vladislav Gavrikov's OT goal lifts Rangers over Stars 3-2

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Troy Stecher and Scott Laughton both got their first goals of the season, Dakota Joshua added a goal and an assist, and the Toronto Maple Leafs topped the Florida Panthers 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maple Leafs jump out to quick lead, hold off Panthers for 4-1 win

headlines.description: — Reid Schaefer and Ozzy Wiesblatt each scored their first NHL goal, Juuse Saros made 27 saves and the Nashville Predators defeated the Calgary Flames 5-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schaefer and Wiesblatt's first NHL goals lead Predators over Flames 5-1

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored two more goals and Gabriel Landeskog had two assists, leading the Colorado Avalanche to a 3-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores twice as the Avalanche beat the Canucks 3-1

headlines.shortLinkText: Wallstedt earns 4th shutout of the season as Wild beat Oilers 1-0

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.shortLinkText: Hart helps lead Golden Knights to 4-3 shootout win over Blackhawks

events.name: Washington Capitals at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Anthony Beauvillier scored the tiebreaking goal early in the third period and Logan Thompson made 24 saves in the Washington Capitals' fifth straight victory, 3-1 over the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beauvillier's tiebreaking goal sends Capitals past Kings 3-1, into 1st place with 5th straight win
